summary: Iteration 4 — targeted regression for the user-reported 'empty categories / disconnected profile after login' bug. Created /app/backend/tests/test_auth_session_fix.py with 15 pytests, all passing (15/15) against the public preview URL. (1) POST /api/auth/session with an invalid session_id returns 401 as expected (backend correctly performs the single Emergent exchange with X-Session-ID); missing body returns 422; GET /api/categories without Bearer returns 401 (auth-gated). (2) With a synthetic user + user_sessions doc in Mongo (Bearer flow), every screen-critical endpoint returns 200 with non-empty data: /auth/me returns the user object (no MongoDB _id leak), /categories returns grouped standard=9, proximity=16, payment=4, providers_online>0 (seeded bots online), manifesto has >=6 items, /wallet returns balance+transactions[], /trust returns provider+client scores/subscores/weights/events, /bookings, /requests ({payments,missions}), /chat/conversations all OK. (3) Full mission lifecycle regression passes: create -> pending, bot auto-accepts within ~15s -> matched, /select -> confirmed booking (jobby_fee = 15% of labor), /start -> in_progress + check_in_on_time=true, /complete -> completed, /review -> provider rating updated + reviews_count incremented in DB. (4) Admin gating verified: /admin/categories & /admin/trust/recalc return 403 without / with wrong X-Admin-Token, 200 with 'jobby-admin-7c2f9a' (>=29 categories, recalculated>=1). The refactor into routers/ is intact; ownership guards flagged in iter 3 (missions/{id}/select 403, bookings /start /complete /review /rate-client /dispute 403) are now in place and enforced. The reported bug is resolved at the backend contract level.

rca_of_issue: RCA (of user bug): frontend AuthContext previously called Emergent's GET auth/v1/env/oauth/session-data itself, got back a session_token, then sent that TOKEN to backend POST /api/auth/session. Backend calls session-data a SECOND time with the received value as X-Session-ID; since session-data is single-use and the value was no longer a session_id, backend received !=200 -> raised 401 -> no user_sessions row inserted -> every subsequent Bearer request 401 -> UI shows empty categories/profile. Fix (frontend): send raw session_id straight to backend so backend performs the single exchange. Backend contract unchanged. Verified: invalid id still 401 (test_invalid_session_id_returns_401); once a valid session exists (simulated via direct Mongo insert), ALL screen endpoints return 200 with the expected non-empty data (categories 9/16/4, providers_online>0, wallet, trust, bookings, requests, chat).
